issues.title: Card modals use two different dismiss buttons
issues.detail: Dialogs in this area use three dismiss treatments. Edit card limits dismisses with a borderless ghost "Cancel"; the Freeze, Change Card Nickname, Transfer card and shipping-address dialogs use a filled grey "Go back" pill with more padding; Archive budget and Assign budget use the same filled grey pill but label it "Cancel". Same role, two labels, two variants.
issues.evidence: Edit card limits Cancel: bg rgba(0,0,0,0), padding 4px 24px, 40x97px. Freeze/Nickname Go back: bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), padding 8px 32px, 40x122px. Archive budget Cancel: bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), padding 8px 32px, 40x113px. All labels 15px/480 Arcadia Text, radius 9999px.

issues.title: Modal titles and buttons mix Title Case and sentence case
issues.detail: The card More menu says "Edit nickname" and "Edit limit", but the resulting dialogs are titled "Change Card Nickname" (Title Case, different verb) and "Edit card limits" (sentence case). The limits primary button is "Save Limit" (Title Case) next to "Cancel"; the nickname primary is just "Save".
issues.evidence: Both titles render 19px/400/28px Arcadia Text in white; texts: "Change Card Nickname" vs "Edit card limits"; buttons "Save Limit" vs "Save".

issues.title: Edit card limits title is not a heading
issues.detail: The Change Card Nickname and Freeze dialogs expose their title as an h2, but the Edit card limits dialog renders an identical-looking title in a plain span, so it has no heading role for screen readers.
issues.evidence: Nickname title: <H2> 19px/400/28px 'Change Card Nickname'; Freeze: <H2> 19px/400; Archive budget: <H2> 19px/400; Edit card limits title: <SPAN> 19px/400/28px with no heading role.

issues.title: Card More menu is clipped by the detail panel
issues.detail: The More dropdown renders inside the detail panel instead of a portal, so on a virtual card the last item (Cancel card) is cut off by the panel edge and only reachable by scrolling the panel.
issues.evidence: With Show details expanded on the Facebook ads card: menu items span top 661 to Cancel card bottom 922; the panel ancestor ._large_kwlx6_9 has overflow 'hidden auto' and bottom 868, so Cancel card (top 869) sits entirely outside the visible panel.

issues.title: Replacement flow content column jumps between steps
issues.detail: The full-screen Order replacement flow left-aligns each step at a different x position, so the heading and form jump horizontally as you advance: step 1 "What happened to your card?" starts at x=510, step 2 "Confirm Shipping Address" at x=566, and the success step heading at x=576 (with the success banner back at 510).
issues.evidence: Measured left edges at 1440px viewport: step 1 eyebrow/heading x=510, step 2 x=566, step 3 heading x=576 (28px/380 Arcadia Display). Same flow shell and step rail.

issues.title: Finish button is a smaller variant than the flow primary buttons
issues.detail: In the replacement flow, Next and Confirm are 40px-tall primary pills, but the final Finish button drops to a 32px pill with regular weight text, so the last CTA looks secondary.
issues.evidence: Finish: 15px/400, padding 4px 16px, height 32px, width 72px, bg rgb(82,102,235). Next/Confirm/Freeze card/Save: 15px/480, 40px tall, padding 8px 32px.

issues.title: Replacement flow uses Title Case labels
issues.detail: The replacement flow uses Title Case for step names and options ("Choose Reason", "Confirm Address", "Confirm Shipping Address", "Never Received") while the rest of the card UI uses sentence case ("Edit card limits", "Activate physical card", "Where should we ship this card?"). The same address is called "Your personal mailing address" in the picker and "Your personal address" on the step.
issues.evidence: Text as rendered: step rail "Choose Reason"/"Confirm Address", h1 "Confirm Shipping Address", radio "Never Received"; picker radio "Your personal mailing address" vs step card "Your personal address".

issues.title: Change PIN uses a one-off input and error style
issues.detail: The Change PIN screen uses a custom 64px-tall input with 38px digits, an attached lowercase "save" return-key button and an uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow; its error "Must be 4 digits" has no warning icon and is 13px, while every other card form uses 40px fields with 12px errors preceded by a warning triangle.
issues.evidence: PIN input: 38px/360 Arcadia Text, height 64px, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.08), no border; error 13px/400/20px rgb(252,146,180), no svg. Standard field (Transfer to): height 40px, 15px/400, border 1px solid rgba(252,146,180,0.36) on error; error 12px/400/18px rgb(252,146,180) with a warning svg. Eyebrow "CHANGE PIN": 12px/480, text-transform uppercase, letter-spacing 1px.

issues.title: Validation messages vary in wording and punctuation
issues.detail: Required-field errors in the card flows use four different patterns: "Please complete this field" (no period), "Please enter a valid US state." (period), "Must be a dollar value." (period) and "Must be 4 digits" (no period).
issues.evidence: Rendered error strings captured from the accessibility tree on each form after submitting empty/invalid input.

issues.title: Card edits give inconsistent success feedback
issues.detail: Transferring a card shows a "Card transferred" toast, but saving a nickname, saving a limit, freezing, unfreezing and changing the PIN close silently with no toast, so the user has to spot the change in the panel.
issues.evidence: After Transfer a 'Card transferred' toast rendered; after saving the nickname 'Facebook ads Q4' the dialog closed and no role=status/alert or toast element contained text. Saving the Spend controls policy also closed without a toast while saving an Edit budget form shows 'Changes saved'.

issues.title: Subscription row action icons have no accessible name
issues.detail: Each Subscriptions row ends with two 32px circular icon controls (open link, block) that have no aria-label, title or text, so screen readers announce them as unnamed link/button.
issues.evidence: Adyen N.V. row: <A> 32x32 aria-label=null title=null text=''; <BUTTON> 32x32 aria-label=null title=null text=''; a third <BUTTON> 32x70 with no text or label.

issues.title: Card tables mix header casing and name formats
issues.detail: The Manage table uses sentence case headers ("Spent this month", "Cardholder") and full names ("Jane Black"), while the Subscriptions tab on the same page uses Title Case headers ("Last 30 Day Spend", "Payment Method") and abbreviated names ("Jane B. ••4928"). Reimbursements mixes both in one table ("Team Member" next to "Date", "Status", "Amount").
issues.evidence: Header texts rendered: Manage = Cardholder / Card / Budgets / Spent this month / Type / Account; Subscriptions = Merchant / Last 30 Day Spend / Payment Method / Actions; All expenses = Date / Team Member / Status / Amount / Category / Budget / Receipt / Policy. Name cells: 'Jane Black' vs 'Jane B.'.

issues.title: View card details opens an existing card, not the one just created
issues.detail: After creating a virtual credit card, the success screen shows ••0330 and View card details navigates to /cards/cardid-credit-1, which is the pre-existing AWS billing card (••0330, Software Subscriptions budget). No new row appears in the list, so the confirmation and the destination disagree.
issues.evidence: After Create card with a $1,000 daily limit, View card details navigated to /cards/cardid-credit-1; the panel header reads 'AWS billing / $1,500.00 / Jane Black'; Jane Black still has 9 rows in the list.

issues.title: Secondary pill buttons use two text colors
issues.detail: The filled grey secondary pill appears with grey text as "Go back" in card modals but with blue link-colored text as "Create another" on the card-created screen. Same background, radius and size, different foreground. The equivalent "Submit another" on the expense-submitted screen uses the grey text, so the two success screens disagree.
issues.evidence: Create another: label color rgb(141,164,245), bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), padding 8px 32px, 40px. Go back (Freeze, Nickname): label rgb(221,221,229), same bg/padding/height. Submit another: rgb(221,221,229), same bg/size.

issues.title: Money is formatted four different ways across Cards and Team Spend
issues.detail: Tables render amounts with superscript cents ($200.00 weekly, $1,500.00 spent this month), the Team Spend summary uses flat cents at 34px ($4,593.84), the card panel and limit breakdown use flat cents ($5,000.00, $3,500.00), the same panel abbreviates to "$3.5k available · $5k spend limit", and the Create a card preview drops cents entirely ("Daily spending limit $1,000"). Within single rows the formats also split: budget detail shows "$183.89 / $250" (superscript cents, then none) and Team members lists "$92.59" next to "$450" and "$200", and the budget sidebar reads "Total budget ($2,000)" above "$534.11 spent".
issues.evidence: Table cell: span._superscript_1of3b_35 10.95px inside a 15px cell, top -2.9px. Team Spend summary: 34px '$4,593.84' with no superscript child. Panel button text: '$3.5k available · $5k spend limit'. Create a card preview: 'Daily spending limit $1,000'. Team members Available: $92.59, $450, $200, $1,038.35, $1,200.

issues.title: Policy inline edit uses a different input and button size
issues.detail: Editing the receipt policy swaps in a filled, underline-style amount input (4px top radius, no border) and 32px Cancel/Save pills with regular weight, while every other form in this area (Edit card limits, Create a card, Edit budget, Submit expense) uses 40px bordered 8px-radius fields and 40px 480-weight buttons.
issues.evidence: Receipt amount wrapper: 144x30, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), radius 4px 4px 0 0, 1px top border only. Receipt and Spend controls Cancel/Save: 32px tall, padding 4px 16px, label 15px/400. Transfer to field: 40px, radius 8px; modal buttons 40px, 15px/480, padding 8px 32px.

issues.title: Receipt policy shows as on and off at the same time
issues.detail: The Cards page banner offers a "Require receipts for card transactions over $75" switch that is off, and the card-created screen repeats it off, while the Spend Policies page shows the Receipt requirement as active ("Receipt required if transaction amount exceeds $75" with a Disable button).
issues.evidence: Cards: switch "Require receipts for card transactions over $75" [checked=false]. Policies: Receipt requirement row renders Disable + Edit buttons and the $75 threshold chip.

issues.title: GitHub spelled two ways
issues.detail: The Software Subscriptions budget lists the merchant as "GitHub" while Spend Policies lists the same merchant as "Github" in excluded and blocked merchants, and merchant chips differ in size between the two pages.
issues.evidence: Budget detail Allowed merchants chip text "GitHub"; Policies chips text "Github" (two occurrences).

issues.title: Policy form shows validation as a tooltip
issues.detail: Clearing the receipt threshold shows the error as a dark tooltip above the field with an icon inside the input, while every other form in Cards and Team Spend places a pink warning-icon message below the field.
issues.evidence: Policy: 'Please complete this field' renders 13px in rgb(255,255,255) inside a tooltip bubble, not the pink error color. Edit budget and Transfer card: 12px/400 rgb(252,146,180) text with a leading warning svg directly under the field.

issues.title: Two dropdown menu densities for the same overflow pattern
issues.detail: The card panel More menu uses tall, loosely padded rows at 14px, while the budget row Actions menu and the expense More menu use compact 40px rows at 15px. Both are icon + label overflow menus opened from a More / ... button.
issues.evidence: Card More menuitem: height 52px, padding 16px 28px, label 14px/400/20px. Budget row Actions menuitem: height 40px, padding 8px 12px, label 15px/400/24px, radius 4px.

issues.title: Three filter control styles across Cards, Team Spend and Reimbursements
issues.detail: Cards uses a filled pill "Add filter" button with removable chips; Reimbursements uses a bordered 8px-radius "Add filter" next to bordered segmented buttons (All / Pending Review); Team Spend uses bordered 8px-radius dropdown buttons (Status, Active dates, Department, Budget). Same job, three looks.
issues.evidence: Cards Add filter: <button> 32px, radius 9999px, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), no border, padding 4px 16px 4px 12px. Team Spend Status filter wrapper: 32px, radius 8px, border 1px solid rgba(180,183,200,0.2), bg rgba(180,183,200,0.08). Reimbursements Add filter: same bordered 8px style as Team Spend.

issues.title: Expense status badges use misleading colors and Title Case
issues.detail: "Payment Pending" renders with the green success badge even though it is a pending state, and "Declined" uses the same orange warning badge as a Suspended card while the list already has a pink error badge ("Action Required"). Status labels are Title Case ("Payment Pending", "Pending Review", "Details Requested") while card statuses are single words (Frozen, Pending, Suspended).
issues.evidence: Payment Pending: ._success, color rgb(119,197,153), bg rgba(119,197,153,0.2). Declined: ._warning, rgb(252,155,111) on rgba(252,155,111,0.2), identical to the Suspended card badge (._warning, same values). Action Required: ._error, rgb(252,146,180) on rgba(252,146,180,0.2). Pending Review / Details Requested: rgb(221,221,229) on rgba(141,164,245,0.2). All radius 4px.

issues.title: Dates appear in five formats and lists drop the year
issues.detail: The expense lists show dates without a year ("Sep 23", "Oct 1", "Jul 5"), so Oct 1, 2024 rows sit below Sep 2026 rows and look out of order. Elsewhere the same area shows "Sep 22, 2026" in the expense panel, "Sep 22nd at 5:00pm" in its timeline, "September 24, 2026" on the expense review, "Starts August 10, 2026" in the budget preview next to a field reading "Aug 10, 2026", and "Sep 27, 2026 - Oct 4, 2026" in the limit modal.
issues.evidence: All expenses Date column, rows top to bottom: Sep 23, Sep 23, Sep 21, Sep 21, Sep 21, Sep 20, Oct 1, Oct 1, Oct 1, Oct 1, Jul 5. Edit card limits text: 'From Sep 27, 2026 - Oct 4, 2026'. Edit budget preview: 'Starts August 10, 2026, and never expires'.

issues.title: Toast messages vary in punctuation and wording
issues.detail: Toasts in this area mix punctuation, counts and verbs: "Reimbursement submitted." ends with a period, while "Budget published", "Card transferred", "Changes saved", "Reimbursement request declined" and "Team Lunch assigned to 1 team member" do not. Approving one request from the detail panel says "Reimbursement payment approved" but approving one from the bulk bar says "1 reimbursement payment approved". "Budget published" follows a button labelled "Create budget". Declines get the same green check icon as successes.
issues.evidence: Toast text read from role=status after each action and visible in the 2x captures: 'Reimbursement submitted.', 'Budget published', 'Card transferred', 'Reimbursement request declined', 'Changes saved', 'Team Lunch assigned to 1 team member', '1 reimbursement payment approved'. Every toast renders the same green check icon.

issues.title: Same expense status written in two casings
issues.detail: My expenses filters by a chip reading "Details requested" (sentence case) while the badge in the table under it reads "Details Requested" (Title Case). The page also pairs a "Drafts" heading with "Submitted Expenses", and the draft badge reads "Draft - Missing info".
issues.evidence: Rendered strings on /expenses/my-expenses: filter chip 'Details requested', status badge 'Details Requested', section headings 'Drafts' and 'Submitted Expenses', badge 'Draft - Missing info'.

issues.title: Policy qualifiers change case between page and dialog
issues.detail: Spend Policies > Reimbursements labels rules "(Not blocking)" and "(Blocking)"; the Reimbursement settings dialog lists the same rules as "(not blocking)" and "(blocking)". Card spend rules say "if transaction amount exceeds" while reimbursement rules say "for expenses that exceed".
issues.evidence: Policies page text: 'Receipt required for expenses that exceed $50 (Not blocking)', 'must be submitted within 30 days (Blocking)'. Settings dialog: 'Receipt required for expenses that exceed $50 (not blocking)', 'Expenses must be submitted within 30 days (blocking)'.

issues.title: Enabling self-approval skips the confirmation that disabling a rule gets
issues.detail: Disabling the Notes requirement asks "Disable rule?" with Go back / Yes, disable. Enabling Self-approval, which lets approvers sign off on their own reimbursements, applies instantly with no dialog and no toast; the only feedback is the button turning into Disable.
issues.evidence: After clicking Enable: no new role=dialog, no role=status text, and the Self-approval row now renders a single 'Disable' button. Disable on Notes requirement opens a dialog with 'Go back' and 'Yes, disable'.

issues.title: "Non-budget" spelled two ways in one card
issues.detail: The display-options switch reads "Include non-budget spend" but the legend entry it adds reads "Non budget spend" with no hyphen.
issues.evidence: Leaf text nodes on /team-spend after toggling: 'Include non-budget spend' (switch label) and 'Non budget spend' (legend).

issues.title: Assign dialog relabels its primary button mid-flow
issues.detail: The Assign budget dialog opens with a disabled "Assign" button that turns into "Next" once a member is picked, then step 2 shows "Assign" again. The button's label changes under the cursor instead of the dialog showing a stable Next on step 1.
issues.evidence: Accessibility tree: dialog 'Assign Team Lunch' buttons Cancel / Assign (disabled) before selection; Cancel / Next after selecting Abigail Kyte; step 2 'Set up budget cards' buttons Back / Assign.
